span.t-esc: request.env['ai.customer.branding'].sudo().search([('company_id', '=', request.env.company.id), ('active', '=', True)], limit=1).brand_name or request.env['ir.config_parameter'].sudo().get_param('ai.brand.name.%s' % request.env.company.id) or request.env['ir.config_parameter'].sudo().get_param('ai.brand.name') or 'Company AI'

title.t-esc: request.env['ai.customer.branding'].sudo().search([('company_id', '=', request.env.company.id), ('active', '=', True)], limit=1).product_title or request.env['ai.customer.branding'].sudo().search([('company_id', '=', request.env.company.id), ('active', '=', True)], limit=1).brand_name or request.env['ir.config_parameter'].sudo().get_param('ai.brand.name.%s' % request.env.company.id) or request.env['ir.config_parameter'].sudo().get_param('ai.brand.name') or (title or 'Company AI')
